Women

Love God More | Love His Word More | Love Others More



The Forest Baptist Church Women's Ministry is dedicated to diligent and creative efforts for discipleship and outreach. Our desire is for women to be spurred on to use their gifts to serve the body, and to mature in their faith, so that whatever we do we bring glory to God.

Fellowship


"Equipping Workshops" and "Sweet Life" are large group gatherings which encourage our growth in faith and discipleship.

Park Together


For moms of young children, we provide coffee, a devotion for mom and a devotion/activity for the kids. Guests welcome.

AM & PM Bible Studies


There are ongoing Bible studies that meet weekly in the morning or evening. Watch the Sunday bulletin or email us for more info.

DVPC Partnership


We partner with the Domestic Violence Prevention Center to help care for the material and spiritual needs of women who find refuge from domestic violence at the DVPC.

Word-for-Word Scripture Memory


Join with other women through video chat to memorize God's Word together. Groups form periodically. Email us for more info.

Meal Support


We organize Meal Train support to care for church members in a time of need or as they welcome home new babies.

For questions or more information about our women's ministry, email women@forestbaptistchurch.org
